robot.name: Tesla Optimus Gen 2 / v2.5

evidence_items.title: Gen 2 investor update
evidence_items.claim: Tesla said it introduced second-generation Optimus using Tesla-designed actuators/sensors and improved AI capabilities.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: Tesla investor update says second-generation Optimus was introduced.

evidence_items.title: Gen 2 demo claims
evidence_items.claim: Tesla-produced Gen 2 demo coverage reported walking, squatting, egg handling, dancing, tactile fingers, 11-DoF hands, and a 30 percent walking-speed improvement.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: Ars summarized the Tesla Gen 2 video and claimed improvements.

evidence_items.title: Laundry demo was not autonomous
evidence_items.claim: The January 2024 shirt-folding demo should not be credited as autonomous; Musk clarified Optimus could not yet do that autonomously.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: TechCrunch reported the demo was pre-scripted/not autonomous.

evidence_items.title: Event interactions human-assisted
evidence_items.claim: We Robot service/social interactions were reported as human-assisted to some extent and should not count as autonomous service evidence.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: Axios reported Tesla Optimus interactions needed human help.

evidence_items.title: Q4 2025 call keeps factory work at basic/R&D level
evidence_items.claim: On Tesla's Q4 2025 earnings call, Musk described Optimus as having done some basic factory tasks while older versions are deprecated during iteration; heise separately summarized the same call as Optimus still being in R&D and not materially productive.
evidence_items.notes: Strong negative/caveat evidence for deployment scoring; transcript is secondary-hosted but reports Tesla's earnings-call statements.
evidence_items.arena_relevance: Prevents treating factory claims as sustained productive deployment.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: Q4 2025 call transcript says Optimus had done basic tasks and older versions were deprecated; heise reports Musk said the robot remained in R&D.
evidence_items.source_location: Tesla Q4 2025 earnings call transcript and heise call coverage
evidence_items.verification_notes: Use as current caveat against productive deployment; no unit count, uptime, task duration, or customer validation was provided.

evidence_items.title: Official updates show Optimus factory capacity under construction
evidence_items.claim: Tesla's Q4 2025/Q1 2026 update decks list Optimus manufacturing capacity in California/Texas as construction or being installed in anticipation of volume production, not current production output.
evidence_items.notes: Official manufacturing-status evidence; supports future production intent but not current robot capability.
evidence_items.arena_relevance: Distinguishes manufacturing preparation from deployed robot usefulness.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: Tesla update decks list Optimus capacity as construction and production lines being installed in anticipation of volume production.
evidence_items.source_location: Tesla Q4 2025 and Q1 2026 update decks
evidence_items.verification_notes: Official source; should not be scored as customer deployment or active production volume.

evidence_items.title: v2.5 framed as transitional before Gen 3
evidence_items.claim: Tesla's Q4 2025 update says Gen 3 will include major upgrades from version 2.5, including Tesla's latest hand design, making v2.5 a transitional prototype rather than the expected production design.
evidence_items.arena_relevance: Prevents over-weighting v2.5 demos as production-hardware proof.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: Tesla says Gen 3 would include major upgrades from v2.5, including the latest hand design.
evidence_items.source_location: Tesla Q4 2025 update deck robotics section
evidence_items.verification_notes: Official roadmap claim; no independent Gen 3 benchmark or production evidence included.

arena_prompt_summary.one_paragraph_summary: Tesla Optimus Gen 2/v2.5 has company demo evidence for locomotion and basic manipulation, but public autonomy and deployment claims are heavily caveated by disclosed non-autonomous or human-assisted demos, official construction/pre-volume-production status, and 2026 call/reporting that frames factory work as basic/R&D rather than productive deployment.
